verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a deploy platform that ships a CLI and dashboard, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains nothing documenting a way to disable telemetry or usage tracking. The only related item (netlify-docs-17) describes Netlify's analytics for tracking team and visitor behavior, which is an adjacent feature, not an opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
